name: Upload for Jelly
description: Accepts photo uploads from a client and files them into a photo library.
overview: Photo upload endpoint for photo libraries.

versions.changelog: Runs on Jellyfin 12: the same binary serves 10.11.6 and later, and was tested on 10.11.6 and 12.4 with identical results. Have now refuses an oversize body with 413 TOO_LARGE instead of a 500 the client would retry, and an upload that runs the volume out of space answers 507 INSUFFICIENT_STORAGE instead of a retryable 500. Requires Jellyfin 10.11.6 or later. The endpoints may still change before 1.0.0.0.

First published release. Uploads go only into a library an administrator ticks on the plugin's page; none is open by default. Targets lists where the caller may write, Have answers which photos the server is missing, and Items streams a photo in, verifies its hash and files it under its capture month. A photo with no date inside the file takes the date from the name the plugin gave it. Requires Jellyfin 10.11.6. The endpoints may still change before 1.0.0.0.
